summary: Temporary restricted area around The Cenotaph, London, within 2.5 nautical miles, up to 2,500 feet, applying to all aircraft, drones, balloons and parachutes.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED (THE CENOTAPH, LONDON) WI
2.5NM RADIUS OF 513009N 0000734W. APPLIES TO ALL ACFT INCLUDING
ANY SMALL BALLOON, ANY KITE, ANY UAS AND ANY PARACHUTE INCLUDING
A PARASCENDING PARACHUTE OR PARAMOTOR. DOES NOT APPLY TO ANY ACFT
FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH EXCEPTIONS STATED IN THE BRIEFING
SHEET. A BRIEFING SHEET BFS 124/2026 WITH CHARTS, REFERS. FURTHER
DETAILS WWW.NATS.AERO/AIS. RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE
UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-8671/01.
